        function isIe() {
            var ua = window.navigator.userAgent;
            var msie = ua.indexOf("MSIE ");
            var version;
            // 判断是否IE11
            if(ua.toLowerCase().indexOf('like gecko') > 0){
                version = 11
            }else{
                if (msie > 0 || !!navigator.userAgent.match(/Trident.*rv\:11\./)) { // If Internet Explorer, return version number
                    version = parseInt(ua.substring(msie + 5, ua.indexOf(".", msie)));
                } else { // If another browser, return 0
                    version = false;
                }
            }
            return version;
        }
        if(isIe() == 9){
            document.write('<script src="https://cdn.careersite.tupu360.com/csresources/scripts/plugin/bootstrap/3.3.7/js/bootstrap.min.js?v=20261016" integrity="sha384-Tc5IQib027qvyjSMfHjOMaLkfuWVxZxUPnCJA7l2mCWNIpG9mGCD8wGNIcPD7Txa" crossorigin="anonymous"><\/script>')
            document.write('<link href="https://cdn.careersite.tupu360.com/csresources/scripts/plugin/bootstrap/3.3.7/css/bootstrap.min.css?v=20261016" rel="stylesheet" type="text/css"/>')
            document.write('<link href="https://cdn.careersite.tupu360.com/csresources/styles/default/ie.css?v=20261016" rel="stylesheet" type="text/css"/>')
            document.write('<script src="https://cdn.careersite.tupu360.com/csresources/scripts/ie9.js?v=20261016" integrity="sha384-4sEGj5Vd0CvImP65FoTBj9Q+UdpRSvh4RKPOjLgVMOXIMHu1GEt//GaIxIz534tf" crossorigin="anonymous"><\/script>')
            
        }else if(isIe() == 10){
            document.write('<link href="https://cdn.careersite.tupu360.com/csresources/styles/default/ie10.css?v=20261016" rel="stylesheet" type="text/css"/>')

<script nonce="e4b6273dd950476a8ba7f8174bbb7a93">
    jQuery(function ($) {
        $.ajaxSetup({
            cache: false,
            error: function(response){
                if(response.status ===  310){
                    with(window.document){
                        open();
                        write(response.responseText);
                        close
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        $.ajax({
            url:"/siemens/position/positionTotal",
            data:{recruitmentType:'CAMPUSAMBASSADORRECRUITMENT'},
            cache:false,
            success:function (data) {
                if(data.positionTotal){
                    $("#campusAmbassadorTab").show()
                } else {
                    $("#campusAmbassadorTab").hide()
                }
            }
        });
    });

    $(".share-qr-float .btn").on("click",function () {
        $(".share-qr-float input").select();
        document.execCommand("Copy")
    });

    // 移动端显示菜单
    $(".actions-bar .btn-show").on("click",function () {
        $(this).parents('.actions-bar').toggleClass('show-actions')
        $(this).parents('.actions-bar').siblings('.actions-bar').removeClass('show-actions')
    })

</script>

                <div><strong>Why Choose Us?</strong></div><div> </div><div>Founded in 1922, SGP (Siemens Graduate Program) is a time-honored Siemens trainee program for master graduates who want to change the future. SGP offers you the ideal start to your career – your opportunity to prepare yourself for a successful career at Siemens. </div><div><br></div><div>Designed as an intensive and internationally oriented two-year program, the SGP will prepare you for future leadership tasks, offering both flexibility and diverse work experiences. The program, which enables you to actively integrate your interests and your qualifications, consists of three to four challenging assignments. At least one of these assignments will take place abroad at one of our 1,700 international business locations. On this international rotation, you will learn about the local business and culture while taking on various responsibilities and project work. </div><div><br></div><div>These are highly appreciated by our current SGP participants include material and immaterial advantages.</div><div>•<span style="white-space: pre;">	</span>Competitive compensation package</div><div>•<span style="white-space: pre;">	</span>Tailored trainings</div><div>•<span style="white-space: pre;">	</span>Given responsibility and own projects</div><div>•<span style="white-space: pre;">	</span>International work that has a significant contribution</div><div>•<span style="white-space: pre;">	</span>Be part of a global network</div><div>•<span style="white-space: pre;">	</span>Assignment abroad</div><div><br></div><div>You will also receive an intensive training program and the opportunity for personal development. A personal Development Manager will be at your side for the duration of the program, helping you to achieve your various objectives while promoting your development and assisting you in planning your career.</div><div><br></div><div><strong>What will you do if join us?</strong></div><div><br></div><div>•<span style="white-space: pre;">	</span>You will gain deep insights from challenging work             var volApplyBtn = '<a  class="btn btn-outline-secondary ml-3 btn-vol-apply-black" id="application" pType ="CAMPUSRECRUITMENT" pid="6aa37e3b7280da28da079988"  style="display:none">选好了，去投递简历</a>';
            var addVolBtn = '<a  class="btn btn-primary" id="volunteer" pid="6aa37e3b7280da28da079988" pType ="CAMPUSRECRUITMENT" style="display:none">添加到志愿</a>';
            var collectBtn = '<span class="btn text-primary"  title="收藏" id="collection" pid="6aa37e3b7280da28da079988">收藏</span>';
            var collectedBtn = '<span class="btn text-primary collection" title="取消收藏" id="collection" pid="6aa37e3b7280da28da079988">已收藏</span>';
            var goPositionListBtn = '<a  class="btn btn-primary" id="goPositionList" data-action="positionList" data-projectid="6a98e2ddcdf4e85c06bb86b6" data-recruitmenttype="CAMPUSRECRUITMENT" style="display:none">返回列表</a>';

            var isApplication = "false";
            var isCollection = "false";
            var content = '<div class="btn-group-toggle">';
            var staffNotApply = "";
            var currentPositionInRemoveVols = "";

            if(true){
                content += getApplyStr()
            } else {
                if(false){
                    
                    var tips = "<div class='deliver-notice'> <span class='txt'>您已认证为员工身份，请勿投递！</span> </div>";
                    staffNotApply = tips
                }
            }

            if (false) {
                content += recommendBtn;
                if(true){
                    content += '<input type="hidden" name="fromRecommend" value="false" id="fromRecommend" />';
                }
            }

            content += "</div>";
            
            if (isCollection === "false") {
                content += collectBtn
            } else {
                content += collectedBtn
            }
            

            if( false){
                if ("false" === "true" && ("false" === "false" || "" === "true")) {
                    $("#positionDetail").append('<div class="" id="volunteerPanel"></div>');
                }
            }

            $("#positionDetail").append('<div class="btns text-center justify-content-between d-flex " id="buttonDiv">'+content+'</div>');

            if( "false" === "true" && staffNotApply){
                $("#buttonDiv").prepend(staffNotApply)
            }


            function getApplyStr() {
                var applyHtml = "";
                if (isApplication === "false" || currentPositionInRemoveVols==="true") {
                    if (false && false && "" !=="N") {

                        
                        applyHtml += addVolBtn;
                        applyHtml += goPositionListBtn;
                        applyHtml +=volApplyBtn;
                        

                    } else {
                        applyHtml += applyBtn
                    }
                } else {
                    applyHtml += appliedBtn
                }

                return applyHtml
            }
        });
    </script>

    function toApplyPosition(){
        v.showLoading();
        var pid;
        var recruitmentType;
        if( true){
            if (false && "" !=="N") {
                pid = $(".volunteer-orders li:eq(" + 0 + ")").children(".position").attr("pid");
                recruitmentType = $(".volunteer-orders li:eq(" + 0 + ")").attr("pType");
            } else {
                pid = $('#application').attr("pid");
                recruitmentType = $('#application').attr("pType");
            }
        }else{
            pid = $('#application').attr("pid");
            recruitmentType = $('#application').attr("pType");
        }
        var prevPositionId = "6aa37e3b7280da28da079988";
        console.log("toApplyPosition pid:",pid, "; recruitmentType:", recruitmentType)
        commonRequest(null, function(){
            $.getJSON("/siemens/application/deliveryTotalByRecruitmentType",
                {positionId: pid, recruitmentType:recruitmentType,projectId:"6a98e2ddcdf4e85c06bb86b6"},
                function (data) {
                    if (data.success) {
                        if(pid){
                            var sourcePid = $("#sourcePid").val();
                            //跳转申请页面
                            var url = "/siemens/resume/applicationView?positionId=" + pid;
                            var projectId = "";
                            if (projectId != "") {
                                url = url+"&projectId="+projectId;
                            }
                            if(""){
                                url = url+"&jobFairCode="+"";
                            }
                            if("CAMPUSRECRUITMENT"){
                                url = url+"&prt="+"CAMPUSRECRUITMENT";
                            }
                            if(false){
                                url +="&prevPositionId="+prevPositionId;
                            }
                            window.location.href = url;
                        }else{
                            v.hideLoading();
                            v.showAlert('请先添加志愿！');
                        }
                    } else {
                        v.hideLoading();
                        v.showAlert(data.message);
                    }
                });
        });
    }


    // 收藏/取消收藏
    $('body').on('click', '#collection', function(e) {
        v.showLoading();
        var pid = $(this).attr("pid");
        var flag = $(this).hasClass("collection");
        console.log("flag:",flag)
        if (flag === false) {
            commonRequest(null, function() {
                $.getJSON("/siemens/position/favorite", {positionId: pid},
                    function (res) {
                        v.hideLoading();
                        if (res.success) {
                            v.showAlert('收藏成功！');
                            if ($("#collection").is(':has(span)')) {
                                $("#collection").html('<span class="icons i-been-heart p-1" style="font-size: 1.5em"></span><span class="txt">已收藏</span>');
                                $("#collection").attr("title", '取消收藏');
                            } else {
                                $("#collection").text('已收藏');
                                $("#collection").attr("title", '取消收藏');
                            }

                            $("#collection").addClass("collection");
                        } else {
                            v.showAlert('收藏失败！');
                        }
                    })
            });
        } else {
            commonRequest(null, function() {
                $.getJSON("/siemens/position/cancelCollection", {positionId: pid},
                    function (res) {
                        v.hideLoading();
                        if (res.success) {
                            v.showAlert('取消收藏成功！');
                            if ($("#collection").is(':has(span)')) {
                                $("#collection").html('<span class="icons i-heart p-1"  style="font-size: 1.5em" ></span><span class="txt">收藏</span>');
                                $("#collection").attr("title", '收藏');
                            } else {
                                $("#collection").text('收藏');
                                $("#collection").attr("title", '收藏');
                            }

                            $("#collection").removeClass("collection");
                        } else {
                            v.showAlert('取消收藏失败！');
                        }
                    })
            });
        }

    $('body').on('click', '#recommend', function(e) {
        v.showLoading();
        var pid = $(this).attr("pid");
        //跳转推荐页面
        var url = "/siemens/resume/relatedPosition?type=recommend&positionId=" + pid;
       // window.location.href = url;
       // commonRequest(url, null);
        $.ajax({
            url: getVisitUrl("login", "userIsLogin"),
            dataType: "json",
            type: "post",
            async:false,
            success: function (data) {
                if(data.login){
                    if(data.isEmployee != "Y"){
                        v.showAlert('企业仅接受内部员工推荐！');
                    }else{
                        if(thatIsWindows()){
                            window.open(url);
                        } else {
                            window.location.href = url
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    v.hideLoading();
                    if($("#fromRecommend").length > 0){
                        $("#fromRecommend").val("true");
                    }
                    showLoginFrom();
                    $("#signInModule").modal();
                }
            }
        });
        v.hideLoading();
    });

    $('body').on('click', '#volunteer', function(e) {
        if("true" !== "true" && $("#addVolTips").length > 0){
            $("#addVolTips").modal('toggle');
            addVolNode = this;
        } else {
            addVolToProject(this)
        }
    });

    /* 志愿排序 */
    var volunteerActions = {
        'init': function () {
            const $this = this;
            const $doc = $(document);

            $doc.on('click', '.volunteer-box .i-up', (e) => $this.up(e.currentTarget));
            $doc.on('click', '.volunteer-box .i-down', (e) => $this.down(e.currentTarget));
            $doc.on('click', '.volunteer-box .i-remove', (e) => revokeDelivery(e.currentTarget));

            // $(".volunteer-box .i-up").each(function (i,w) {
            //     $(w).on("click",function () {
            //         $this.up(w)
            //     })
            // });
            // $(".volunteer-box .i-down").each(function (i,w) {
            //     $(w).on("click",function () {
            //         $this.down(w)
            //     })
            // });
            // $(".volunteer-box .i-remove").each(function (i,w) {
            //     $(w).on("click",function () {
            //         revokeDelivery(w, i)
            //     })
            // })
        },
        'remove': function (box) {
            var $this = this;
            var $father = $(box).parentsUntil('.volunteer-orders');
            var $box = $father.eq($father.length-1);
            $box.find('.position').empty()
        },
        'up': function (box) {
            v.showLoading();
            var $this = this;
            var $father = $(box).parentsUntil('.volunteer-orders');
            var $box = $father.eq($father.length-1);
            var $prev = $box.prev();
            $this.move($prev, $box)

        },
        'down': function (box) {
            v.showLoading();
            var $this = this;
            var $father = $(box).parentsUntil('.volunteer-orders');
            var $box = $father.eq($father.length-1);
            var $next = $box.next();

            $this.move($box, $next)
        },
        'move': function (down, up) {
            $(".volunteer-box").addClass('running');
            down.addClass('move-down');
            up.addClass('move-up');
            var $downPosition = up.find('.position');
            var $upPosition = down.find('.position');
            setTimeout(function () {
                $($downPosition).remove(".actions");
                $($upPosition).remove(".actions");
                $($downPosition).appendTo(down);
                $($upPosition).appendTo(up);
                down.removeClass('move-down');
                up.removeClass('move-up');
                $(".volunteer-box").removeClass('running');
                saveVolunteers()
            },299)

        }
    };
    // volunteerActions.init();

    function saveVolunteers() {
        var pId;
        var volunteers = [];
        var pType
        $(".volunteer-item").each(function (i, e) {
            var volunteerNo = $(e).attr("volunteerNo");
            var positionId = $(e).find(".position").attr("pid");
            var positionName = $(e).find(".position").attr("pName");
            var recruitmentType = $(e).find(".position").attr("pType");
            var deliverId = $(e).find(".position").attr("deliverId");
            var applicationId = $(e).find(".position").attr("applicationId");
            var uid = $(e).find(".position").attr("uid");
            pType =  $(e).find(".position").attr("pType");
            var volunteer = {};
            volunteer.volunteerNo = parseInt(volunteerNo);
            volunteer.positionName = positionName;
            volunteer.positionId = positionId;
            volunteer.recruitmentType = recruitmentType;
            if(deliverId){
                volunteer.deliverId = deliverId;
            }
            if(applicationId){
                volunteer.applicationId = applicationId;
            }
            if(uid){
                volunteer.uid = uid;
            }
            volunteers.push(volunteer);

            if(volunteerNo === "1"){
                pId = positionId
            }
        });
        commonRequest(null, function() {
            $.ajax({
                url: "/siemens/application/saveVolunteer",
                data: {
                    volunteers: JSON.stringify(volunteers),
                    recruitmentType: pType,
                    projectId: "6a98e2ddcdf4e85c06bb86b6"
                },
                success: function (res) {
                    if (res.success) {
                        v.showAlert('调整成功');
                        $("#volunteerPanel").html(res.content);
                        adjustBtnShow(res.volunteers)
                    } else {
                        v.showAlert('调整失败');
                    }
                }
            });
        });

        v.hideLoading();
    }

    function adjustBtnShow(vols, appliedRemoveVol){
        var maxPrioCount = 3;

        var hasVol = false;
        var hasNoApply = false;
        var thatVolApplied = false;
        for(var i =0; i < vols.length; i++){
            var vol = vols[i];
            if(vol.positionId === "6aa37e3b7280da28da079988" || (vol.sourcePid && vol.sourcePid === "1949363")){
                hasVol = true;
                if(vol.applicationId){
                    thatVolApplied = true;
                }
            }

            if(!vol.applicationId){
                hasNoApply = true
            }
        }

        if(vols.length < maxPrioCount && !hasVol){
            $("#volunteer").show();
        } else {
            $("#volunteer").hide();
        }

        if(hasVol){
            if(thatVolApplied){
                $("#applicationed").show();
                if(appliedRemoveVol){
                    console.log("thatVolApplied appliedRemoveVol");
                    $("#volunteerPanel").remove();
                }
            } else {
                $("#applicationed").hide();
                $("#addedVolunteer").show()
            }
        } else {
            $("#applicationed").hide();
            $("#addedVolunteer").hide();
        }

        if(hasVol && vols.length < maxPrioCount){
            $("#goPositionList").show();
        } else {
            $("#goPositionList").hide();
        }

        if(vols.length < 1 || !hasNoApply){
            $("#application").hide();
        } else {
            $("#application").show();
        }
    }


    setTimeout(function () {
        buttonShow();
    }, 5);
    function buttonShow(){
        var positionStatus = $("#positionStatus").val();
        if(positionStatus !== "PUBLISHING"){
            $("#buttonDiv").removeClass("d-flex");
            $("#buttonDiv").css('display', 'none');
        }
    }

    var hasApplyShowApplyFunction = false

    function isShowApplyBtn(callback) {
        if(hasApplyShowApplyFunction){
            return
        } else {
            hasApplyShowApplyFunction = true
        }
        if($("#application").length > 0) {
            $.ajax({
                url: "/siemens/user/allowApply",
                data: {},
                success: function (res) {
                    if (res.allowEdit != false) {
                        $("#application").show()
                    } else {
                        $("#application").remove();
                        if($("#goPositionList").length > 0){
                            $("#goPositionList").remove()
                        }
                        if($("#volunteer").length > 0){
                            $("#volunteer").remove()
                        }
                    }

                    if(callback){
                        callback.call();
                    }
                }
            });
        } else {
            if(callback){
                callback.call();
            }
        }
    }

    function revokeDelivery(box) {
        v.showLoading();
        //删除志愿
        var pid = $(box).parents('li.volunteer-item').find(".position").attr("pid");
        var pType = $(box).parents('li.volunteer-item').find(".position").attr("ptype");
        var params = {positionId: pid, recruitmentType:pType};
        var projectId = "6a98e2ddcdf4e85c06bb86b6";
        if (projectId != "") {
            params.projectId = projectId
        }
        $.getJSON("/siemens/application/delVolunteer",params,
            function (res) {
                v.hideLoading();
                if (res.success) {
                    v.showAlert('删除志愿成功');
                    $("#volunteerPanel").html(res.content);

                    adjustBtnShow(res.volunteers);
                } else {
                    v.showAlert('删除志愿失败');
                }
            });
    }

    $("#addVolEnter").click(function () {
        $("#addVolTips").modal('hide');
        addVolToProject(addVolNode)
    });

    $("#addVolCancel").click(function () {
        $("#addVolTips").modal('hide');
        addVolNode = null
    });

    function addVolToProject(that){
        v.showLoading();
        var pid = $(that).attr("pid");
        var recruitmentType = $(that).attr("pType");
        var params = {positionId: pid, recruitmentType:recruitmentType};
        var projectId = "6a98e2ddcdf4e85c06bb86b6";
        if (projectId != "") {
            params.projectId = projectId
        }
        commonRequest(null, function() {
            $.getJSON("/siemens/application/volunteerAndDeliverCount", params,
                function (data) {
                    if (data.success) {
                        //保存志愿
                        $.getJSON("/siemens/application/addVolunteer", params,
                            function (res) {
                                v.hideLoading();
                                if (res.success) {
                                    v.showAlert(res.message);
                                    $("#volunteerPanel").html(res.content);
                                    adjustBtnShow(res.volunteers);

                                    addVolNode = null;
                                } else {
                                    v.showAlert(res.message);
                                }
                            });
                    } else {
                        v.hideLoading();
                        v.showAlert(data.message);
                    }
                });
        });
    }

    $(function () {
        
            $("#application").show();
        

        if( false) {
            if ("false" === "true" && ("false" === "false" || ""==="true") && "" !=="N") {
                var _volunteer_params = {positionId: '6aa37e3b7280da28da079988',recruitmentType: 'CAMPUSRECRUITMENT'};
                var projectId = "6a98e2ddcdf4e85c06bb86b6";
                if (projectId !== "") {
                    _volunteer_params.projectId = projectId;
                }
                $.get("/siemens/application/detail",
                    _volunteer_params,
                    function (data) {
                        $("#volunteerPanel").append(data);

                        
                        const vp = $("#volunteerPanel");
                        if(vp.length > 0 && !vp.hasClass("card")){
                            vp.addClass("volunteer-box card-normal card")
                        }
                        
                        volunteerActions.init();
                        volunteerInitBtnShow();
                    });
            }
        }

        function volunteerInitBtnShow() {
            let vols = $("#volunteersJson").val();
            if(!vols){
                vols = []
            } else {
                vols = JSON.parse(vols);
            }
            isShowApplyBtn( function () {adjustBtnShow(vols, true)});
        }

    })
</script>

    function HTMLDecode(text) {
        var temp = document.createElement("div");
        temp.innerHTML = text;
        var output = temp.innerText || temp.textContent;
        temp = null;
        return output;
    }
    var cookieValue = $.cookie('acceptCookiePolicy');
    if(cookieValue == "false" || cookieValue == undefined){
        $("#pixel-consent-container").css("display","flex");
    }else if(cookieValue == "true"){
        $("#pixel-consent-container").hide();
